en.name: Ventriloquist
en.ability: If a player is mad as a fresh character during their nomination, they might not die if executed today.
en.flavor: Well, folks, gather ‘round! This here’s my pal Charlie, and he’s got a mouth on him that’d make a mule blush. But don’t worry folks, I do all the talkin’... or do I?
